questions.q: What is a Lightning app, fundamentally?
options: A separate piece of software that must be installed from the AppExchange
A named, branded collection of tabs and navigation items that points users at particular objects
A synonym for a connected app used for OAuth integrations
A type of permission set exclusive to System Administrators
questions.explain: The lesson opens by clarifying that an app in Salesforce is a named, branded set of tabs and navigation — not separately installed software.

questions.q: Where does a user go to switch between apps they have access to?
options: The Setup gear icon
The App Launcher, opened from the grid icon in the top-left of Lightning Experience
Object Manager
The Profile edit page
questions.explain: The App Launcher shows every app a user has access to, plus a searchable list of individual tabs and items beyond their current app.

questions.q: In the New Lightning App wizard, what does the App Details & Branding step control?
options: Which profiles can access the app
Which tabs appear in the app's navigation
The app's name, description, icon, and highlight color
The utility bar's docked tools
questions.explain: App Details & Branding is where you set the app name, developer name, description, icon image, and primary color for the navigation bar.

questions.q: A profile is left in "Available Profiles" (not moved to "Selected Profiles") on a custom app's User Profiles step. What happens for users on that profile?
options: They see the app but cannot open any of its tabs
They receive an error message when they try to find the app
They simply never see the app in their App Launcher — it isn't an error, just invisible to them
They see the app only in Salesforce Classic, not Lightning Experience
questions.explain: The User Profiles step is access control: a profile not moved into Selected Profiles just doesn't see the app at all, silently.

questions.q: Which two topics does this lesson explicitly say are covered in more depth in the next two lessons?
options: Record types and page layouts
Navigation items (which tabs appear) and utility items (the utility bar)
Permission sets and permission set groups
Global value sets and dependent picklists
questions.explain: The lesson previews that Navigation Items are covered in the next lesson (Tabs and Navigation) and Utility Items in the lesson after that (Utility Bar and Console Apps).
